text:
maria: Heads-up — working proposal to expose a compact SLO alert configuration in Console. Goal: let owners set noise-tolerant thresholds and an escalation window without wrestling with raw alerting YAML.

samir: +1. can you sketch the main knobs? most teams want a simple default but ability to override per-route.

maria: Thinking 3 knobs: 1) threshold (pct or absolute), 2) noise-tolerance (minutes of sustained breach), 3) escalation window (how long before paging). Also a mute-on-rollout toggle for canaries.

kevin: mute-on-rollout toggle is 🔑. Product teams are tired of pagers during gradual canaries.

anya: UX question — should noise-tolerance be a slider (0–30m) with examples? e.g., "5m catches blips, 15m catches sustained regressions".

ruth: backend concern: our notifyPolicy schema is already complicated. we shouldn't duplicate logic. Could the Console emit a compact policy that server-side expands into the full rule set?

maria: Yes — Console -> sends simplified policy, service translates to low-level alerts. Proposed client payload:

```
{
  "slo_id": "route:/v1/generate",
  "threshold": {"type":"pct","value":0.99},
  "noise_tolerance_minutes": 10,
  "escalation_minutes": 30,
  "mute_during_rollout": true
}
```

samir: That looks fine. Implementation note: we need deterministic mapping so we can diff/eval policy rollouts.

kevin: Also need a preview UI that shows estimated alert volume and sample past incidents if applied (like "if this rule had existed, you'd have X pages in last 7d").

anya: We can wire a simulator endpoint that replays metric windows against the expanded policy and returns hits. Small UX: show a red/orange/green traffic-light summary.

ruth: On the API side I want an `expanded_policy_id` or `derived_from` field so we track provenance. Also audit logs for console edits.

maria: +1 on audit logs. ops-bot: can you record a follow-up task for infra to add a simulator job for 1 week of data replay? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Task created: INF-3281 "SLO policy simulator endpoint" — assignee: eng-sre triage queue.

kevin: minor: when we auto-expand compact policy, ensure we don't create duplicate alert channels for teams that already have custom routes. Merge strategy: prefer existing notify channels unless overridden.

samir: security/permission check: only owners of the target route can edit SLOs in Console. Need an API check.

maria: noted. final open question: defaults. I propose noise_tolerance default 5m, escalation_minutes default 15m, mute_on_rollout default true for canary-enabled routes.

anya: sounds reasonable. I'll mock UI and the preview graphs — will drop screenshots in a follow-up thread.

maria: thanks all. I'll draft a spec doc and the compact JSON->expanded mapping and post here. tagging: @kevin @ruth for API review.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feat/slo-console-compact (CI passed)
